lines: So far indeed that waveless Bhairava-formed,
which in own self shows forth-dissolve-variety's utmost.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tāvat hi tad ataraṅgaṃ bhairavavapuḥ yat svātmani avabhāsitasṛṣṭisaṃhārāvaicitryakoṭi
